lines.text: Parents are only mom and dad!
Many learners say: I have many parents in this city.
Better: I have many relatives in this city.
Parents are only mom and dad.
Relatives! My aunts are my relatives.

data.wrong: I have many parents in this city.
data.right: I have many relatives in this city.
data.why: Parents are only mom and dad.

quiz.stem: My cousins and aunts are my ___.

native.tip: En español “parientes” son todos los familiares, pero “parents” en inglés son solo padre y madre. Para familiares: “relatives.”

en.tip: In Spanish “parientes” are all family, but English “parents” are only mom and dad. For the rest, say “relatives.”
